meal.title: Understand strings for rock‑paper‑scissors
meal.objective: You can recognise and write text values called strings

voice.script: What does a piece of text look like in code? How do we store words like rock or paper? In Python a string is a piece of text written inside single or double quotes. For example, the word rock becomes a string when we write "rock". Strings let us represent words, sentences, or any characters. Now we create three string variables for the moves and print them. The program defines rock, paper, and scissors as strings and prints each one. Running this prints each word on its own line. Remember, strings are just text inside quotes. Try adding a new move called lizard as a string and print it.
